## Surgeon

Dr. Steven Nelson, DDS, MD. Board-certified oral and maxillofacial surgeon. Raised in Baton Rouge. LSU undergraduate (biological sciences). DDS, LSU School of Dentistry, New Orleans (top of class; Horace Wells Excellence in Dental Anesthesia Award; Excellence in Implant Dentistry Award; C. Edmund Kells and OKU). Six-year OMFS residency at LSU with an MD. General surgery internship at University Medical Center in New Orleans. Teaches residents at Our Lady of the Lake Regional Medical Center.

Memberships listed: American Dental Association, American Medical Association, Louisiana Dental Association, American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons.

## Services

- Wisdom teeth
- Dental implants (surgeon places the fixture; restorative dentist makes the tooth)
- Jaw surgery (orthognathic)
- IV sedation / outpatient general anesthesia (anesthesia specialist on staff; wisdom-teeth page names Dr. Dickerson)

## Areas named

Prairieville · Ascension Parish. One published location. No second office on the official site.

## Contact

Call (225) 402-2303. Online patient registration is published. The web form is a callback; the desk confirms surgery by phone. Do not invent reviews, extra locations, or social profiles. louisianaosc.com does not publish a star rating or review widget.
